This is facilitating fraud, i.e., "帮助诈骗罪" (helping fraud). In Chinese criminal law, there is a specific offense: "帮助诈骗罪" (Article 266 of Criminal Law). Also possibly "非法获取金融机构资金罪"? But they are not the ones who deceived victims, they just withdrew money. Under Chinese law, they can be charged with "帮助诈骗罪". So answer: [罪名]帮助诈骗罪<eoa>.
